critical_code_review_comments: server.py L1094-1097 (create_phone_order): idempotency check runs BEFORE db.orders.insert_one, returning the existing order via Order.from_mongo(dup). This means a duplicate POST (e.g. iPad double-tap) never inserts a second document and thus never reaches accept_order → do_print again. Correct.

server.py L1114-1115: `AcceptIn(time=body.requested_time) if body.requested_time not in (None, '', 'asap') else AcceptIn(minutes=30)` matches the spec exactly (HH:MM → time; asap/None → minutes=30). Note: when the caller says 'in N minutes' with N != 30, L1103-1105 rewrites body.requested_time to fmt_time(now+N min), so the AcceptIn(time=...) branch is used with the correct minute count.

server.py L1543-1546 (do_print): durable print_lock via find_one_and_update on `{printed: {$ne: True}, print_lock: {$exists: False}}` – exactly-once print across devices, retries and restarts. Combined with L1625 `if not claimed.get('printed')` in accept_order, phone-order acceptance can never emit two tickets.

server.py L1280-1325 (closing_report): identity resolution uses `driver_name` snapshot first (L1263-1264) then falls back to the shift open at assigned_at/delivered_at/created_at (L1266-1276). Slot-only closings (no driver_name yet) are shown as legacy — correct. Cash bucket at L1306 uses `(o.get('collection_method') or 'cash') == 'cash'` which correctly treats None as cash (matches review spec 'in (null, cash)').

frontend/app/staff/closing.tsx L103: toggle label = `${d.orders.length} commandes · ${d.deliveries} livraisons` then conditionally appends `· K en cours` (only when d.orders.length - d.deliveries - d.cancelled > 0) then `· C annulées` (only when d.cancelled > 0). Matches spec 'N commandes · M livraisons · K en cours · C annulées'.
